_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002). Never add tasks for individual worlds here

tasks.title: Read-only region-file reader as a BlockStore adapter, so planning/dry runs do not need paced MCP reads
tasks.notes: Why: dry runs were hours because planners read the live world one block at a time through paced MCP calls (1.1 s each; see docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md S-02/S-19; #106/#108/#110 patched three layers). Region files are already on disk (world config region_path). Scope: STRICTLY READ-ONLY reader of .mca files (never write, copy, snap, restore or delete region files), implemented as an adapter behind BlockStore (read/read_many) so planners are unchanged; used for planning and dry-run reads after a server save (server_save_all_worlds; rules/process.md already says save before reading region files). Applies and their readback stay on the existing MCP path unless shown safe. Policy: GLOSSARY.md and ADR 004 say to avoid parsing region files for block state and removed region backup/restore; the owner has authorised this read-only exception (2026-10-26), so record it in ADR 004 / GLOSSARY when shipping. Open questions to answer first: does anything in planning need live state not on disk (unsaved chunks, entities, block entities); how to detect stale reads (save then read; compare chunk timestamps); chunk formats/version (DataVersion 4903); reuse an existing NBT/anvil library vs write minimal; keep dependency count low.

tasks.title: Ground and decor read the vector-map cache the pipeline builds
tasks.notes: Cause: ground_sources.load_osm globs only *-mp/-ln/-pt.geojson in verification/site/osm27700, but osm_footprints writes <clip-dir>__<clip>.geojson, so the ground and decor layers load zero roads, paths, plazas, hedges, walls (S-20, S-21). Scope: one shared reader of the cache osm_footprints builds (reproject clips not yet cached); read every geojson there so legacy names still work; bbox filter and dedupe already exist. The dry run prints "vector map: N features" (reporting only, no stop: an empty cell is legitimate). Fix the stale docstring. Done when a world with only __-named clips yields roads and hedges in OSMGround. Evidence and method: docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md, "Investigation findings". One regression test only; no new gates or lints.

tasks.title: Feature-build portal doors choose the nearest candidate, then check framing
tasks.notes: Cause: Build.framed returns only strict candidates found anywhere on the face, dropping nearer ones, so portals 18-A, 42-B, 40-A fall outside DOOR_REACH and are skipped (S-08). Scope: feature_build portal_doors only: pick the candidate nearest the portal, then apply framing. Do NOT change framed() semantics: house_build uses it (test_house_build asserts the current behaviour) and the front/rear door callers stay as they are. Done when the four existing specs place doors for 18-A, 42-B, 40-A in a dry run. Evidence and method: docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md, "Investigation findings". One regression test only; no new gates or lints.

tasks.title: Feature margin no longer fills stone shelves around the footprint
tasks.notes: Cause: Build.clear() fills the 2-block margin around every footprint with stone at floor level b (range(37,b) plus a stone at b), regardless of terrain (S-17). Scope: clear the margin but do not fill it; keep stoop/step cells at doors (step_out and kset rely on ground at b). Recommended over the alternative of letting the ground layer re-surface build-owned margin columns. Blocked by #114 only because both edit feature_build.py (drop the edge if worked in separate worktrees). Done when a dry run shows no stone outside the footprint except stoops. Evidence and method: docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md, "Investigation findings". One regression test only; no new gates or lints.

tasks.title: Zoned footprints keep only cells with lidar mass
tasks.notes: Cause: the footprint is the vector outline (closed/opened); lidar sets heights only, and snap_to_levels gives every outline cell a roof level even over bare ground (S-09, S-22, part of S-18). Jubilee: 357 of 3138 cells (after the exclude boxes) have no mass of at least 3 m. Scope: labels with a zones entry only (Retail has none). Intersect the readable mask with lidar mass (nDSM threshold as a named constant, not hard-coded; check it does not carve low porches/canopies); keep the exclude key as an override. Verify offline against the four existing specs, reporting cover % before and after (no redos of applied builds). Blocked by #115 only for same-file edits. Evidence and method: docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md, "Investigation findings". One regression test only; no new gates or lints.

tasks.title: Block store scans the surrounding 16x16x16 section on a cache miss
tasks.notes: Cause: LiveBlocks.read calls _ensure([p]): one block per scan at 1.1 s, so any layer that forgets to prefetch stalls for hours (S-02, S-19). Scope: on a miss scan the containing section (a chunk column is about 98k blocks, over the 65,536 per-scan cap). Makes the #106/#108/#110 prefetch patches redundant but leave them. Complements #111 (read-only region reader speeds dry runs; this protects live applies and any path bypassing the reader); do not merge them. Evidence and method: docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md, "Investigation findings". One regression test only; no new gates or lints.

tasks.title: propose-features calls missing_features and surfaces errors
tasks.notes: Cause: cell_registry.propose_feature_candidates calls cell_features.propose_for_cell, which does not exist, inside a bare except returning [] (S-06). lib/journal/cell_features.py already has missing_features(tx, tz), which also returns a houses kind (surfaces the University Road houses as candidates, S-07; registering them stays manual). Scope: call missing_features, drop the swallowing except. Note: registry_next.next_task orders ground first by design and only reads registered features; that disagrees with rules/handoff-layered-passes.md and is a separate owner decision, not part of this ticket. Evidence and method: docs/snags/2026-10-26-southampton-48-44.md, "Investigation findings". One regression test only; no new gates or lints.
